class.name: RosClient
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Service Client for making requests to a service server.
class.description: [RosClient] allows Godot to act as a client for ROS 2 services. It is created through [method RosNode.create_client] and is used to send requests and receive responses asynchronously. Communication follows a request-response pattern: the client sends a [RosMsg] request and receives a [RosMsg] response. Use the [method async_send_request] method to send a request which will return a [RosRequest] object, which acts as a handle for the request. Use this handle to wait for the response or get it when ready.

method.name: async_send_request
method.description: Sends a service [param request] asynchronously. Returns a [RosRequest] object that can be used to track the progress of the request and retrieve the response.

method.name: create_request
method.description: Creates and returns an empty [RosMsg] of the correct type for this client's service requests.

method.name: wait_for_service
method.description: Blocks until the service server is available or the [param timeout_sec] is reached. Returns [code]true[/code] if the service is available.
